name: MAC
description: MAC (Multimodal Academic Cover) is a live benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on scientific understanding using over 25,000 image-text pairs from top scientific journals. It challenges models to reason across abstract visual and textual scientific content and evolves continuously with scientific progress.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the authors of the paper, with little established community adoption yet but likely to be of interest for multimodal scientific reasoning research.
notes: Live benchmark that updates yearly with new scientific journal covers; focuses on cross-modal scientific reasoning.
